route_title: Local gradient refinement from Round 1 best candidate with ±5% perturbation seed
compilation_rationale: Topology override fixes 12 alternating HfO2/SiO2 layers. Initial thicknesses scaled from provided list by ±5% multiplicative factor. Four spectral targets enforce desired R/T response and suppress complementary behavior across disjoint bands. Gradient optimizer clipped to 0.5 nm step limits. Relative uniform tolerance models manufacturing spread.
